name: Search More Hovels
summary: Among the Murloc hovels, you have found no sign of the Menethil Statuette. So you press farther north, seeking the next clue.

sections.title: Northward Search
sections.body: You believe the Menethil Statuette lies in one of the hovels to the north. So you continue your search among the Murloc dwellings.

faq.answer: You are searching the Murloc hovels for the Menethil Statuette.

faq.q: Did these hovels have the statuette?
faq.answer: A thorough search of this group of hovels reveals nothing.
You believe one of the Murloc hovels farther north may hold the Menethil Statuette.
